name: Pau (Spain)
description: White field with the blue peacock of the arms in the first vertical third.
history: The municipal council of Pau approved the flag on 2 September 2003 and it was published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 3997 of 28 October 2003, with a correction on 22 June 2004; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, white, with the blue royal peacock of the arms 7/9 of the height in the first vertical third.

features.role: royal peacock (pao) of the arms, 7/9 of the height
